holdings.infrastructureStrategyBasis: Generate Capital finances and owns distributed energy, waste, water, and sustainable infrastructure assets consistent with Harbert’s infrastructure equity mandate.
holdings.northAmericaBasis: Generate Capital operates and finances infrastructure assets across the United States.

evidence.title: Harbert Management Corporation Announces Agreement to Acquire Generate Capital
evidence.evidenceSummary: Harbert announces acquisition of Generate Capital, establishing ownership and infrastructure investment strategy linkage.

evidence.title: Generate Capital Official Website
evidence.evidenceSummary: Describes Generate Capital as an owner and financier of distributed infrastructure assets across the U.S., supporting North American scope and active operations.

holdings.repoDispositionRationale: No existing repository records; direct Harbert infrastructure platform investment.

holdings.infrastructureStrategyBasis: Hamakua Energy is a utility-scale independent power producer asset aligned with Harbert’s power and infrastructure investment strategy.
holdings.northAmericaBasis: The asset is located and operates in Hawaii, United States, serving local grid infrastructure.

evidence.title: Harbert Acquires Hamakua Energy
evidence.evidenceSummary: Harbert acquisition of Hamakua Energy confirms ownership and classification as an infrastructure power asset.

evidence.title: Hamakua Energy Official Website
evidence.evidenceSummary: Describes the facility as a Hawaii-based power generation asset, confirming North American location and ongoing operations.

holdings.repoDispositionRationale: No repository match; standalone Harbert-owned infrastructure asset.

excludedCandidates.rationale: Gulf Pacific Power functions as a Harbert-owned operating/holding vehicle within its infrastructure portfolio rather than a distinct third-party platform, so it is not separately counted.
Harbert Infrastructure Fund VI is a fund vehicle and represents LP/fund exposure rather than a direct operating infrastructure company or asset.
Harbert Power Funds I-V are fund vehicles providing capital to investments and do not constitute direct infrastructure operating holdings.
Astoria Project Partners was previously owned by Harbert but has been exited and is no longer an active holding as of the as-of date.
Northern Star Generation was sold by Harbert and is no longer part of the current infrastructure portfolio.

excludedCandidates.companyName: Calhoun Energy Center / East Alabama Generating
excludedCandidates.rationale: Calhoun Energy Center (East Alabama Generating) has been divested and therefore is excluded as a realized investment.
Individual assets financed or owned by Generate Capital are underlying portfolio projects and are excluded because Generate Capital is counted at the platform level.

notes: Reviewed Harbert infrastructure and power strategy materials and portfolio disclosures.
Searched for acquisition and exit announcements to confirm current ownership states.
Validated Generate Capital and Hamakua Energy as the only in-scope North American direct holdings.
Excluded fund vehicles, realized assets, and subsidiary-level exposures per methodology.
